blocks.content: Course: Make Your Code Work on Every Screen

The nav stacks vertically on mobile now. But think about it. Four links sitting in the header before any content means the user has to scroll past all of that just to see the page. On a phone that's a lot of wasted space.
The fix is hiding the nav behind a button. The user taps it to open the links, taps again to close. On wider screens the button disappears and the nav is always visible.
That little ☰ button is what we're building in this lesson.
▶️ Next, let's see how it works.
